parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy is offering 1 Wood for 1 Wheat. I currently have 2 Wheat and 1 Sheep. I desperately need Wood and Brick to build towards the 3:1 port at N51. Jimmy recently got Wheat from the roll of 3, so he's building up, but I need the Wood more than I need the second Wheat right now to keep my expansion plans alive. Accepting this helps me get closer to a road/settlement while maintaining a decent relationship with Jimmy to counter Claude.
parsed.note_to_self: Accepted Jimmy's trade: 1 Wheat for 1 Wood. Current resources: 1 Sheep, 1 Wheat, 1 Wood. Still need Brick to build a road towards N52/N51.
parsed.say_outloud: טוב נו ג'ימי, שכנעת אותי. עץ זה בדיוק מה שחסר לי כדי להתחיל לזוז לאנשהו. רק אל תבזבז את החיטה הזאת על שטויות של קלוד.
